x: Double wins also came from vaulters Paul Williams and Lucy Webber - although Lucy had to share first place with a rival. The irrepressible Maria Sharp was the unlucky person to find herself "only" in third when she tackled the 800m.
Lucy Webber, recovering from a broken finger, battled for a valuable silver in the pole vault. In the triple jump Caroline Stead gained bronze for more valuable points.
Hence we learnt that Diana Holden's 52.88 in the hammer, Lucy Webber's 3.40 in the pole vault, and Eva Massey's 14.98 in the shot were all Grade 1 performances.
In the pole vault it was a one-two for Lucy Webber and Jenny Searle and in the shot Eva Massey's massive throw of 15.77 metres was a Club Record (outdoors).
